title: 20/50 5minEMA Cloud: Stage 1 slow-touch opportunity paths
summary: Fixed-width slow EMA touches in ES, GC and NQ on 3m and 5m candles; 2018–2020 development paths, censored counts and dependence-aware uncertainty. Path observations do not estimate profitability.

sections.title: Stage 1 development findings
sections.body:
The pooled H15 signed terminal means do not establish positive continuation under the prespecified four-week uncertainty calculation. Mean adverse excursion exceeds mean favorable excursion in every pooled primary cell. Pooled intervals do not describe every side or session: negative subgroup findings and block-length sensitivities remain in the saved tables. Equal-active terminal contrasts are inconclusive; some excursion contrasts differ. Coverage improves markedly toward 2020, and early GC annual cohorts are sparse, so pooled evidence does not establish stability across years. Exact review references: provenance/reviews/interpretation-review.json; coverage S1-T00, primary and side scorecards S1-T02, annual/session S1-T04, uncertainty S1-bootstrap and contrasts S1-comparisons.

sections.title: Frozen definitions and uncertainty
sections.body: EMA20/EMA50 cloud stays on five-minute closes. Fixed inclusive widths: ES 2.4, GC 2.0, NQ 10 points. Slow touches only, both directions, one signal per pullback, zero cooldown. A five-minute signal uses its current completed close-derived cloud; a three-minute signal freezes the latest scheduled cloud completed at its open. Missing latest features clear state. Features reset on rolls/unknown gaps and require 250 consecutive usable five-minute observations; known scheduled closures preserve same-contract state. Overlapping observations are retained. H counts scheduled active chart slots. H15 means 45 active minutes on 3m and 75 on 5m. Equal-active comparisons are 3m H20 versus 5m H12 (60 minutes), and 3m H50 versus 5m H30 (150). Actual elapsed minutes and closure-crossing support remain separate. Quantiles interpolate at p(n−1); top-tail cutoffs are percentiles, not tail averages. Terminal signs use strict zero; MFE>MAE uses epsilon 1e−10×max(1,MFE,MAE), with ties retained. Pointwise 95% uncertainty uses paired contiguous New York calendar-week blocks, four-week primary, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261010; one/eight-week sensitivity remains descriptive. Event means and contributing-session balanced means have different denominators. Calendar labels use signal-open New York dates; weeks start Monday. Fixed time strata are Asia 18–03, Europe 03–09, US 09–16 and Late 16–18. Session balancing uses trading-session identity. No strategy selection or profitability estimate is implied.

sections.title: Coverage and interpretation limits
sections.body:
2018–2020 development observations only; later-period outcomes remain reserved. Prior Abacus studies inspected some later market history, so this is not a pristine market holdout. Unadjusted same-contract prices; reference is confirmed signal close and the signal candle is excluded. MFE and MAE are path observations, not executable profits, stops or targets. Sparse cohorts have fewer than 100 completed events or 30 contributing sessions. Modeled completion is available_at; original vendor-receipt and mapping-arrival times are absent. Uncertified holiday/early-close sessions are excluded conservatively and reset feature history. Missing no-trade minutes cannot be distinguished reliably from source loss.

Verified published partition bytes and retained release lineage support this descriptive analysis. Original raw source reconstruction could not be certified because retained mapping/definition prerequisites are unavailable; native TradingView equivalence and off-device backup verification were not executed. These qualifications are distinct from the passed consumed-input and scientific checks.
